gold_posts.topic: How to layer vitamin C and retinol
gold_posts.hook: Vitamin C in the morning. Retinol at night. Never the two at once.
gold_posts.caption: They are both powerful, and both unnecessary to combine. Antioxidant protection by day, cellular renewal by night. Separated, they work with your skin's own rhythm.
